scope: Only the Mods card panel and its search input routing; preserve the existing three-column cards, buttons and order.

layout.alignment: Centered over the three-column card area; existing scrollbar gutter retained.
layout.scrolling: Search row remains fixed; cards are clipped below it.

behavior: Live, case-insensitive module display-name substring matching with outer whitespace trimmed.
Clearing the search restores all existing cards in their original order; filtered cards cannot receive clicks.
Changed queries reset scrolling; UI scale changes preserve the search and its focus.
Focused text input consumes editing keys and prevents HUD selection/movement shortcuts.
Escape/Enter release search focus; clicking outside or closing the panel releases focus.

performance.normalized_names: Cached once when the panel is initialized.
performance.filter_rebuild: Only when the normalized query changes; reuse the same result list and original card objects.
performance.draw_and_click: Iterate the cached results without lowercasing or matching names.
performance.viewport: Reuse parent layout parameters; no glGetInteger, GL attribute push/pop, scissor buffer, or ScaledResolution allocation in the search render path.
performance.panel_closed: No search rendering or filtering while the Mods panel is closed; small initialized caches remain in memory.
performance.limits: Search text/background rendering and clipping have normal UI costs; small name/reference caches use memory. Absolute zero overhead is not claimed. No in-game FPS or visual benchmark was performed.
